profiles.name: Macedonian Pike
profiles.note: Nine 1,000-man stands represent approximately 9,000 phalangites; six taxeis are not six equally sized 1,000-man units.

profiles.name: Hypaspists
profiles.note: The 12,000 Macedonian foot are reconstructed as 9,000 phalangites plus 3,000 hypaspists. Equipment and game classifications are interpretive.

profiles.name: Allied Hoplites
profiles.note: Expeditionary contingent included; exact participation in the river assault is not established.

profiles.name: Greek Mercenaries
profiles.note: Expeditionary contingent included; not all need be deployed at the river in a smaller engagement.

profiles.name: Odrysian Peltasts
profiles.note: The 3/2/2 allocation of the combined 7,000 Balkan troops is a scenario convention, not a surviving census.

profiles.name: Triballian Infantry
profiles.note: Part of the conjectural 3/2/2 Balkan allocation; shared regional artwork is representative.

profiles.name: Illyrian Infantry
profiles.note: Part of the conjectural 3/2/2 Balkan allocation; precise tribal dress is not known.

profiles.name: Agrianian Javelinmen
profiles.note: Half-strength stand. The source gives 1,000 archers and Agrianians combined; a 500/500 split is a convention.

profiles.name: Foot Archers
profiles.note: Half-strength stand; 500/500 allocation is interpretive. Kept separate so bows and javelins remain distinct.

profiles.name: Alexander's Companions
profiles.note: Two stands represent about 1,800 men. Alexander is associated with this contingent, not an extra 1,000 men.

profiles.name: Thessalian Cavalry
profiles.note: Two stands represent about 1,800 men; armor and horse colors vary within the shared Greek cavalry artwork.

profiles.name: Allied Greek Horse
profiles.note: One understrength stand represents about 600 men.

profiles.name: Thracian Paeonian Horse
profiles.note: A combined 900-man contingent. The separately named mounted sarissa scouts in Arrian are not assigned a speculative extra 1,000 men.

profiles.name: Satrapal Cavalry
profiles.note: Conjectural remainder under satrapal commanders and chosen central contingents; the 20,000 total follows Arrian, not a known ethnic breakdown.

profiles.name: Median Cavalry
profiles.note: Expanded from Diodorus for the Arrian-total roster; ethnic allocation is conjectural.

profiles.name: Hyrcanian Cavalry
profiles.note: Named by Diodorus under Spithridates; strength and uniform details are not established.

profiles.name: Bactrian Cavalry
profiles.note: Diodorus names 2,000 Bactrians; four stands here are a conjectural allocation within Arrian’s larger cavalry total.

profiles.name: Paphlagonian Horse
profiles.note: Named by Diodorus under Arsites; exact strength and equipment are uncertain.

profiles.name: Greek Mercenaries
profiles.note: Rounds Arrian’s somewhat-under-20,000 total to 20 bases. This disputed ancient figure is not a secure modern headcount.
